subject: tr-info
title: TR.INFO.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in BK(NM)-9 (Black Notated Music, Level One), on the page where Braxton argues that 'the black composers through the progressional continuance of time have come to be viewed as either lackeys of the western art music continuum, or simply imitators of European classical music. This is not only true for black composers alone, but extends throughout the reception of all non-caucasian composers.' TR-INFO (trans-information) is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications): the question is what trans-information produces when crossed with time-continuum-implications in a culture where reception itself is conditioned by gradualist categorization. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) rises from the main line, with AFI (affinity insight) branching from it and ATTN (attraction) from AFI. (R)SG-CULT-SOLD is the upper-right output, branching from the main line; (P)TH-ALGN (the point of idea completion of thrust alignment) branches from it on the right side. RE-DOC (redocumentation) branches from TH-ALGN, with POL-DY (political dynamics) branching from RE-DOC and INFO-COMP (information compression) from POL-DY. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) drops from the main line to the left, with INFO-TRS branching from it and POST (postulation) from INFO-TRS.
